Interface LogConfig.ChangePublisher

Enclosing interface:
LogConfig
public static interface LogConfig.ChangePublisher
Config Change Publisher. By default this is enabled with "logging.global.change" set to true, which then gates two independent, per-logger-name properties: "logging.change" + "." + logger name, set to a list of LogConfig.ChangePublisher.ChangeType or true/false to enable or disable all changes, and "logging.caller" + "." + logger name, set to a LogEvent.Caller.CallerType (or true/false) to control caller info. The two are resolved independently - one does not imply or override the other, even for overlapping logger name prefixes.

    • callerType

      LogEvent.Caller.CallerType callerType(String loggerName)
      The caller info strategy for a logger, resolved from "logging.caller", independently of allowedChanges(String) /"logging.change". Unlike LogConfig.ChangePublisher.ChangeType.LEVEL, which is genuinely re-evaluated on every publish(), this is resolved once when a logger is first created and never revisited afterward - it reflects a static per-logger capability, not something that changes at runtime.
      Parameters:
      loggerName - logger name.
      Returns:
      caller type, LogEvent.Caller.CallerType.NONE if not configured.
